name: jr-commit-coach
description: Nudges you toward small atomic commits: when uncommitted changes pass a threshold, a band and a toast suggest a split by folder.

threshold.title: Threshold (lines)
threshold.description: Uncommitted lines (added + removed) from which the coach speaks up.

showBand.title: Show the band
showBand.description: Keep the reminder above the prompt while the pile stays over the threshold.
